Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through the FinWave conversational support use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Call recap (high level):
- Priority workload: high-frequency customer support routing + policy extraction from 3-5k ticket histories (short-utterance + context).
- Targets: p95 latency for generation <= 350ms, throughput ~30 qps during peak, and strict PII handling (no persistent customer data in logs).

Model fit recommendations (initial):
- Redwood-13B-8k (FP16 / 4-bit AWQ): best balance of cost/latency for your throughput requirement; expect good instruction-following and extraction quality on the prompt sets you described.
- Redwood-7B-8k (FP16 / 4-bit AWQ): lower cost option for lower-complexity routing; useful as fallback for cheaper short queries.
- Llama2-70B / Mistral variants (quantized FP8 / GPTQ): only if you need top-tier extraction accuracy on long-context cases — expect higher latency and infra cost.

Quantization / throughput tradeoffs we propose to evaluate:
- AWQ (4-bit): typically best throughput/quality tradeoff for instruction tasks; fast KV cache behavior; often minimal quality delta vs FP16 but depends on prompt distribution.
- GPTQ (4-bit): good for some model families but can introduce brittle regressions on specific prompts; run as a comparator.
- FP8 / mixed FP formats: potentially gives best accuracy at a cost of throughput and infra complexity; evaluate for high-value extraction tasks only.

Requested items (next steps):
1) Can you share a small sample of representative prompts + expected outputs (5-10 examples) and a brief latency/cost target spreadsheet? (Attached is a template we use.)
2) We'll run an internal model-fit eval matrix across Redwood-13B and Redwood-7B with AWQ and GPTQ quantizations, measuring ROUGE/F1 on extraction tasks, generation latency p50/p95, and token cost.
3) Technical deep-dive: 60-min session with Dev Patel (our inference engineer) to align on KMS/networking and any VPC constraints. Proposed slots: Mon 6/14 10am PT or Tue 6/15 1pm PT — which works?

Attachments: sample prompt template and latency-targets workbook (small stubs attached). Also attaching our AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 trade notes for quick reference.

I'll coordinate internal evals once we have your sample prompts. Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Best,
